comment: Shared by rust/examples/speed_bench.rs (native) and scripts/bench/speed-bench-wasm.mjs (WebAssembly). Each case builds its operand with `setup` and times `source` alone; `repeat` concatenates `source` that many times; `elements` turns the time into a per-element figure.

cases.name: fold-add-vecseed
cases.route: FOLD with the idiomatic one-element Vector seed

cases.name: map-collatz-step
cases.source: [ 'N' BIND N 2 DIV N 3 MUL 1 ADD N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL N EQ SELECT ] MAP

cases.name: map-userword-nested
cases.setup: [ 2 MUL ] 'DBL' DEF [ DBL 1 ADD DBL ] 'G' DEF 0 99999 RANGE

cases.name: map-unfused-scalars
cases.route: scalar Words in a block the fused walk declines (quickened)
cases.source: [ [ 7 ] LENGTH ADD 'X' BIND X 2 DIV FLOOR X 3 MUL X 0 LT SELECT 5 GT X 9 LT NOT AND ] MAP

cases.name: map-of-vectors
cases.setup: 0 49999 RANGE [ 'X' BIND X X 2 ADD RANGE ] MAP

cases.name: sort-100k
cases.setup: 0 99999 RANGE [ 'N' BIND N 7919 MUL 'M' BIND M M 100003 DIV FLOOR 100003 MUL SUB ] MAP
